text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Nishino Flower goes on a talk show titled Speaking of That Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a big event held at a large venue
every year.
Nishino Flower is not their
only guest, though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I looove talking! I've been looking
forward to this
event for sooo long!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout you, Taishin?! I bet you've
been
super-duper excited too, right,
Taishin?!
Taishiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do you ever stop talking?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's Narita Taishin, the winner of
the Satsuki
Sho, and Winning Ticket, the
victor of the
Japanese Derby! And that's
not even it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My name is Biwa Hayahide. I'm looking
forward to
speaking with you all today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! Greet the audience properly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
There's Biwa Hayahide, who shared the
Triple
Crown with them, and her younger
sister, Narita
Brian, who won the Asahi
Hai F.S.!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible! I wonder what they're
gonna
talk about today? I'm so glad I
won tickets!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've been invited as a guest to an event
Hayahide
and the others will be
attending as well?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I don't know if I'll be able to
even talk
properly at such a big event...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fans look forward to it every year, and I
heard it's
really tough to get tickets.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I mess up, everyone will be
disappointed...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 不安になったら俺を見てくれ
不安になったら私を見て
choice_data_list_en: If you get anxious, just look at me.
If you get anxious, just look at me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 俺に話す時のように、話せばいいよ
私に話す時のように、話せばいいよ
choice_data_list_en: Just talk to them the way you talk to me.
Just speak the way you do when you talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's right! You'll be there with me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thanks!
choice_data_list: 君はすごいウマ娘だ、堂々としよう！
貴方はすごいウマ娘、堂々としよう！
choice_data_list_en: You're an amazing Umamusumeâhold your head high!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Next up is Nishino Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: H-hello, everyone. I'm Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Thank you so much for coming on
the show
today.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
You started your career with the Hanshin
Juvenile
Fillies and the Oka Sho, then
went on to make
consecutive wins in the
Milers Cup, Yasuda
Kinen, and even the
Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Even only looking at the major races,
you've won
so many titles already!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I... I did my best!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: You're the best, Flower! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for having me here. I hope we
can all
have a great time talking today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew! My heart was racing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower carries on flawlessly in
the talk
show, and the event is a huge
success thanks to
her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I heard you cheering for me in the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And when I did, I remembered to have
confidence
in myself. That gave me the
courage to hold my
head up high!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed, you were fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You handled that interview well, and
with all your
usual earnestness and
grace. Allow me to
congratulate you on
a job well done, as well as
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want to thank me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The event went smoothly thanks to
you
effortlessly carrying the
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Consider the other guests from today.
Ticket is
unpredictable, and Taishin isn't
the most
proactive conversationalist.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, Brian is awkward and
taciturn. Even
before the show started, I
worried if we'd be able
to carry a
conversation at all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your laughter made smiles bloom, and
you did
your best to engage in every
topic. You paid such
careful attention to
the other guests too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, even Taishin and Brian
did their
best to answer earnestly
whenever you turned the
conversation to
them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket's a simple soul. Just being
exposed to your
calm demeanor kept
her similarly serene from
start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We owe it to you for the grand success
of the
event, so thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, it's an honor to be
considered
equal to a great Umamusume
such as you, who
has accomplished so
much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll continue to show your
greatness to
the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hayahide was so generous with
her
compliments.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I was able to hold my head up
high
today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Told me what?
choice_data_list: だから言ったじゃないか
だから言ったでしょう
choice_data_list_en: See? What did I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: 君はすごいウマ娘だって！
貴方はすごいウマ娘だって！
choice_data_list_en: I'm telling you, you're an amazing Umamusume!
I'm telling you, you're an amazing Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I am! Wait, that's not quite
correct.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: We're both amazing. ♪
